```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

#library(googlesheets4)

library(dplyr)

library(reactable)

library(scales)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)

options(scipen = 999)
devtools::load_all("/Users/matt.benigni/Documents/projects/ImmuteR/")

# Load most recent opportunities RData (falls back to latest if today's isn't present)
data_dir  <- "/Users/matt.benigni/Documents/projects/ImmuteR/data/"
rdata_today <- paste0(data_dir, "opportunities_", Sys.Date(), ".RData")
if (file.exists(rdata_today)) {
  load(rdata_today)
} else {
  rdata_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "^opportunities_.*\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(rdata_files) == 0) stop("No opportunities RData files found in ", data_dir)
  load(rdata_files[which.max(file.mtime(rdata_files))])
  message("Note: loaded most recent RData (not today's): ",
          basename(rdata_files[which.max(file.mtime(rdata_files))]))
}

```



## Renewal Forecast

The report was generated directly from Immuta SFDC \``r op_list$dates`` 

```{r renewal_summary, echo=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}

library(plotly)

f=generate_forecast(op_list,churn.quarters=c("Q4-2026","Q1-2027","Q2-2027","Q3-2027","Q4-2027"))



company_plan=c(2178130,814469,476564,836946,1820292)
p=c( sum(company_plan[1]>=f$`Q4-2026`),
    sum(company_plan[2]>=f$`Q1-2027`),
    sum(company_plan[3]>=f$`Q2-2027`),
    sum(company_plan[4]>=f$`Q3-2027`))/1000





fig <- plot_ly(y =f$`Q4-2026`, type = "box", quartilemethod="exclusive",name="FY26Q4",
               showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  add_trace(y=f$`Q1-2027`,name="FY27Q1") %>%
  add_trace(y=f$`Q2-2027`,name="FY27Q2") %>%
  add_trace(y=f$`Q3-2027`,name="FY27Q3") %>%
  
  add_trace(
    x = "FY26Q4",
    y = company_plan[1],
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers+text",
    text= p[1],
    textposition= "right",
    
   marker = list(
     size = 12,
     color = "black",
     symbol = "diamond"),
   name = "Company Plan") %>%
  
  add_trace(
    x = "FY27Q1",
    y = company_plan[2],
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers+text",
    text= p[2],
    textposition= "right",
    
    marker = list(
      size = 12,
      color = "black",
      symbol = "diamond"),
    name = "Company Plan",
    showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  
  add_trace(
    x = "FY27Q2",
    y = company_plan[3],
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers+text",
    text= p[3],
    textposition= "right",
    
    marker = list(
      size = 12,
      color = "black",
      symbol = "diamond"),
    name = "Company Plan",
    showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  
  add_trace(
    x = "FY27Q3",
    y = company_plan[4],
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers+text",
    text= p[4],
    textposition= "right",
    
    marker = list(
      size = 12,
      color = "black",
      symbol = "diamond"),
    name = "Company Plan",
    showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  
  layout(title = paste0("FY26Q4-FY27Q3 Forecast as of ",Sys.Date()),
         yaxis=list(tickformat="$,.2s"))

fig 




```
